causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Maximum temperatures in New South Wales exceeded 40°C on that day. This drove demand to reach a maximum of 12 334 MW at 4.30 pm.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Bushfires in the vicinity of the transmission network around the Snowy Mountains saw multiple outages occur in quick succession leading to the New South Wales to Victoria interconnection being interrupted, electrically separating the two states.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Bayswater 2520 2420 100 Technical issues related to fuel mills Eraring 2880 2580 300 Ambient temperature issues then availability further constrained off due to loss of the interconnector Liddell 1800 1560 240 Technical issues

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Sapphire Wind Farm 187 10 177 Low wind output White Rock Wind Farm 172 9 163 Low wind output

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Imports from Victoria were 470 MW lower than expected, about half of what was forecast four hours ahead. Figure 2 shows imports into New South Wales reduced by up to 900 MW between 3 pm and 3.30 pm, and from the 3.35 pm dispatch interval onwards New South Wales was separated from Victoria during the high price trading intervals.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding of some generation capacity from low to high prices contributed to the price exceeding $5000/MWh.

causes.label: fcas_co_optimisation
causes.quote: Around half of the high priced intervals were set by the co-optimisation between the Energy and the FCAS markets.
